I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread to say PD-5302 is noted as the Marrow Fieldworks follow-up ticket for this week. I took no other action, since they said none was needed.

GBrain had nothing on PD-5302. The only Marrow Fieldworks note is from January 2026, about the account changing hands and two older tickets (#4409 and #4412). I didn't add PD-5302 to GBrain. I can do that if you want it saved somewhere that lasts, because the Slack thread is currently the only record.

GBrain also reported that this connection can't use 124 operations because of the server's starter tool setup. Only the brain owner can change that, by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the brain host.
